bull.b: Revenue has expanded substantially while maintaining strong gross and operating margins, indicating that growth is translating into meaningful earnings power. This combination supports ongoing investment in innovation, marketing and retail expansion while providing a durable foundation for profitable scaling.

DTC is growing faster than wholesale and increasing its share of the business, which can strengthen customer ownership, brand presentation and economics over time. Continued channel mix improvement should give On greater control over pricing, consumer data and product launches.

Sustaining premium prices and limited discounting during broad promotional activity suggests meaningful brand strength and consumer willingness to pay. This supports margin durability, protects brand positioning and gives On more flexibility to invest behind future products and category expansion.

bear.b: Persistent promotional conditions can pressure sell-through, wholesale economics and future pricing discipline, particularly if competitors continue using discounts to attract consumers. Softer online traffic also creates a risk that elevated brand investment will produce slower conversion across some channels.

LightSpray has strong consumer demand, but production constraints and defect management could delay revenue capture and increase execution complexity as capacity expands. Scaling an important technology before manufacturing consistency is fully established may limit near-term contribution.

Asia Pacific remains a major growth market, but the guided moderation from recent growth rates implies a slower contribution to consolidated expansion. A less rapid regional trajectory could reduce operating leverage and place more pressure on the Americas and EMEA to sustain overall momentum.
